d: Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee has alleged that BJP workers attacked his Kolkata residence at around 2 am on Saturday, after conducting surveillance of his office and home for two days. Sharing videos on social media, Banerjee claimed this was the seventh attempt on his life in six months and accused the police and judiciary of inaction. The Bengal BJP has dismissed the allegations, with leader Dilip Ghosh calling them an attempt to mislead people. Here's what happened and what both sides have said.
